units.source_text: 不久後，父親從東京回來，我在自己的房間裡聽到父親大聲對母親說道：「

en.t: Before long, my father came back from Tokyo, and from my own room I heard him saying loudly to my mother, "

units.source_text: 我在商店街的玩具店裡開啟記事本一看，本子裡竟然寫著‘獅子舞’。

en.t: When I opened the notebook in the toy shop on the shopping street, I found that 'lion dance' had actually been written in it.

units.source_text: 嗯？不對，這可不是我的字跡。

en.t: Hm? No, this is not my handwriting.

units.source_text: 我歪著頭納悶了一會兒，立刻想到是怎麼回事。

en.t: I tilted my head and wondered for a while, then immediately realized what had happened.

units.source_text: 這分明是葉藏的惡作劇嘛。
這孩子，先前我問他時，他笑著默不作聲，事後卻又想要了。

en.t: That child, when I asked him earlier, smiled and said nothing, but afterward he decided he wanted it after all.
What a strange child he is.

units.source_text: 他假裝什麼都不知道，卻又工工整整地寫在本子上。

en.t: He pretended not to know anything, yet had written it neatly in the notebook.

units.source_text: 既然這麼想要，直接告訴我不就行了嗎？

en.t: If he wanted it that badly, why did he not just tell me?

units.source_text: 我在玩具店看到後都忍不住笑出了聲，

en.t: When I saw it at the toy shop, I could not help laughing out loud,
